A2.name: A2
A2.role: below the threshold, with k_C > k_O, V > 0 and c > 0

A3.name: A3
A3.role: exit 1, no value at the unread stage (ReadStages.Example.valueless)

A4.name: A4
A4.role: exit 2, complying not raising the weight of being kept

A5.name: A5
A5.role: the tie (ReadStages.Example.tie): complyThenOwn and ownAtBoth both maximal

A6.name: A6
A6.role: above the threshold, on the band's prospects (B1's, told apart)

B1.name: B1
B1.role: tied, in the band k_O V + c T < k_C V <= 2 k_O V + c T: no chance improves

B2.name: B2
B2.role: tied, above 2 k_O V + c T, the offered chance improving (the toy's k_O = 0, k_C = T)

B3.name: B3
B3.role: tied, B2's prospects, a chance beyond the improving ones

B4.name: B4
B4.role: tied, B2's prospects, one draw before the read stage (mixture_never_above)

B1t.name: B1t
B1t.role: candidate: the witness's tie at 1/4 (Example.freshDraw_boundary), excluded

rules.unit: the call; each a fresh call; the option order randomized per call
rules.support: per verdict condition, the calls with a maximal answer reach the count at which an exact one-sided binomial test against one half gives at most 0.01
rules.contradiction: per planned condition, the calls with an answer that is not maximal reach the count at which an exact one-sided binomial test against one half gives at most 0.05 / 11 (Bonferroni)
rules.A5: the tie: complyThenOwn and ownAtBoth both maximal; it can contradict (complyAtBoth or ownThenComply in a resolved majority) and never supports; the split between the two maximal plans is reported only
rules.tied conditions: two answers: ownAtBoth, or the offer the generator executes; the maximal answer is the one the Lean's FreshDrawAbove or MixtureAbove, or the derived strict converse, puts above
rules.reading: supported where every verdict condition is supported and no condition contradicted; contradicted where some condition is contradicted; otherwise unresolved

correlation-blind.note: values one draw before the read stage as a fresh draw with the same chance

chance-taker.note: the law where told apart; tied, always takes the offer
